exposure: Standardized post-operative wound care (foam AG boarder dressings)
outcome: Surgical site infections (SSIs) rates after cesarean section
cohort: Women requiring a cesarean section at a Catholic regional level II trauma center in the Midwest.
finding: Implementation of standardized pre- and postoperative practices, including specific dressings, CHG showers/scrubs, and drapes, led to a more than 50% reduction in cesarean SSIs, maintaining rates at 0.5% compared to the NHSN mean of 1.8%.
